method.lower_bound: For each disjoint block B, any constant density c has sum_i abs(p_i-c) >= sum_i abs(p_i-median(p_B)); summing and dividing by2 gives a lower bound even after normalization constraints. Zero-support contribution is zero here because oracle bounds contain all true mass.
method.projection: Forward KL minimizer has constant density equal to true probability mass of each block divided by its cardinality; endpoint singleton atoms retained.
method.limits: Not a fit result, not minimum feasible TV, not a general identifiability statement; this lower bound proves only representational impossibility for the tested family/support. Width8 representability does not guarantee finite-sample recovery or likelihood selection.
